name: mati-forge
description: Mati Forge: quietly notes the moments you correct Claude, stored only on your computer.

plugins.name: mati-forge
plugins.description: Captures your corrections to Claude, and subagents that fail or are retried, as short local notes. Drafts a rule from each correction for you to keep or drop, briefs Claude with the most relevant rules, and gives a weekly report. Needs the Mati Forge desktop extension.
